# OpenCode Piggy

[中文](README.md) | English

OpenCode Piggy is a self-contained OpenCode V2 plugin that lets the [dsh-piggy](https://github.com/CLICGGER-TYPES/dsh-piggy) desktop pet grow with your work in OpenCode.

The plugin subscribes to OpenCode's public server events, maps work records to events with stable IDs, writes them asynchronously to a persistent local outbox, then delivers them over HTTP to the game's official work-event API. Server events work the same for OpenCode Desktop and the TUI, which share one plugin.

The plugin registers no model tools and does not change model context. You start the pet yourself; the game manages gameplay, values and saves.

| Component | Requirement |
|---|---|
| OpenCode | V2, 2.0.26 or later |
| dsh-piggy | Recommended: 0.37.2-rc.5 (desktop shell 0.6.8-rc.3), started with `--work-events` |
| Plugin version | 0.2.1 |

## Quick start

### 1. Install the plugin

Install the stable release from npm with the OpenCode V2 CLI:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-piggy@latest
```

The command installs a global plugin and writes the configuration for you; there is nothing to download, extract or edit by hand. Reload your project and the plugin takes effect; Desktop and the TUI need no extra setup. The plugin uses only Node built-in modules.

`latest` follows stable releases; to pin a version, install `opencode-piggy@0.2.1`. A pinned version does not move to the next one by itself. To upgrade from `@next` or a pinned RC, remove the old install target before adding `@latest`; the queue is preserved. Without npm, use the GitHub target `github:WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy#v0.2.1::path:packages/opencode-piggy` instead; see the [usage guide](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/opencode.md#用命令行安装) (Chinese).

### 2. Start the game

The plugin only delivers events; you open the game yourself. The work-event API is off by default, so start the official dsh-piggy with `--work-events`. From the official source, run this in `apps/desktop` after installing its dependencies:

```sh
npm run pack-game
npx electron . --work-events
```

With an installed build, add `--work-events` to the app's launch arguments. The [official 0.37.2-rc.5 release](https://github.com/CLICGGER-TYPES/dsh-piggy/releases/tag/v0.37.2-rc.5) includes the required API; `0.6.8-rc.3` in the download filename is the desktop shell version.

After that, use OpenCode as usual and your work is delivered to the pet. To enable it for one project only, install offline from a release archive, or customize directories, see the [usage guide](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/opencode.md) (Chinese).

## Offline and retries

Events are written to disk before delivery; records already persisted are kept while the game is closed and delivered automatically when it starts again. The plugin retries every 5 seconds. The game's acceptance window is 7 days; older events stay on disk and are no longer sent automatically. An event leaves the outbox only after the game returns `applied`, `duplicate` or `ignored`, and retries reuse the original event ID, so nothing is counted twice.

Projects in the same OpenCode service share one dispatcher, which stops when the last project unloads the plugin.

## Directories and data

The plugin first looks for the game endpoint in the official `piggy` data directory. When the game uses a standalone full save, the plugin discovers the endpoint for the active archive without a `gameDirectory` setting. If that endpoint is absent, it checks the default directory below. The event queue stays in its original location:

| System | Game endpoint directory | Plugin queue directory |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | `%APPDATA%/piggy/work-endpoint` | `%APPDATA%/opencode-piggy-plugin` |
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/piggy/work-endpoint` | `~/Library/Application Support/opencode-piggy-plugin` |
| Linux | `$XDG_DATA_HOME/piggy/work-endpoint`, defaulting to `~/.local/share/piggy/work-endpoint` | `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode-piggy-plugin`, defaulting to `~/.config/opencode-piggy-plugin` |

Linux uses `XDG_DATA_HOME` only when it is an absolute path. If the unified data directory has no endpoint, the plugin checks the legacy `dsh-piggy` and `dsh-piggy-desktop` data directories. An explicit `gameDirectory` takes priority; remove it to restore automatic discovery if it still points to an old endpoint.

The queue's `events/` stores only event IDs, types and timestamps, with no chat content, code or tool output. For a custom game data directory or queue location, see the [usage guide](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/opencode.md#配置游戏目录与队列) (Chinese). When reporting issues, do not share `endpoint.json` from the game's endpoint directory, which contains a local authentication token.

## Guides

The [usage guide](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/opencode.md) (Chinese) covers CLI installation and removal, project-level configuration, offline installation, directory options and troubleshooting. The [release guide](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/releasing.md) (Chinese) explains packaging and publishing.

## Development

The repository contains only the plugin:

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `packages/opencode-piggy/` | The plugin: event mapping, persistent outbox, official endpoint discovery and HTTP delivery |
| `scripts/` | Installer script, type check and packaging |

Development dependencies are TypeScript and Node types only, and the source tooling needs Node.js 22.15 or later:

```sh
npm install --ignore-scripts
npm run check
```

To enable the plugin straight from source, run `node scripts/install-opencode.mjs --global` in the repository root, or pass `--project="/path/to/project"` to enable it for one project only. See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.en.md) for version history.

# OpenCode Piggy

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

OpenCode Piggy 是一个自包含的 OpenCode V2 插件，让 [dsh-piggy](https://github.com/CLICGGER-TYPES/dsh-piggy) 桌宠随你在 OpenCode 里的工作成长。

插件订阅 OpenCode 服务端的公共事件，把工作记录映射成带稳定 ID 的事件，先异步写入本地持久发件箱，再通过 HTTP 投递给游戏的官方工作事件接口。服务端事件对 OpenCode Desktop 和 TUI 一视同仁，两者共用同一个插件。

插件不注册模型工具，也不改动模型上下文。小猪由你自己启动；玩法、数值和存档都由游戏管理。

| 组件 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| OpenCode | V2，2.0.26 或以上 |
| dsh-piggy | 推荐 0.37.2-rc.5（桌面外壳 0.6.8-rc.3），以 `--work-events` 启动 |
| 插件版本 | 0.2.1 |

## 快速开始

### 1. 安装插件

用 OpenCode V2 的命令行从 npm 安装正式版：

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-piggy@latest
```

命令默认安装为全局插件并写入配置，不需要手动下载、解压或修改 JSON。重新加载项目后插件生效，Desktop 和 TUI 都不需要额外设置。插件只使用 Node 内置模块。

`latest` 跟随正式版本；要固定版本，安装 `opencode-piggy@0.2.1`。固定版本不会自动跳到下一个版本。从 `@next` 或固定 RC 版本升级时，先移除旧安装目标，再添加 `@latest`，队列会保留。不使用 npm 时，可以改用 GitHub 目标 `github:WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy#v0.2.1::path:packages/opencode-piggy`，见[使用指南](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/opencode.md#用命令行安装)。

### 2. 启动游戏

插件只负责投递，游戏需要你自己打开。工作事件接口默认关闭，启动官方 dsh-piggy 时加上 `--work-events`；如果你从官方仓库的源码运行，在安装好依赖的 `apps/desktop` 目录执行：

```sh
npm run pack-game
npx electron . --work-events
```

使用安装版时，在应用的启动参数里加入 `--work-events` 即可。[官方 0.37.2-rc.5](https://github.com/CLICGGER-TYPES/dsh-piggy/releases/tag/v0.37.2-rc.5) 已包含所需接口；下载文件名中的 `0.6.8-rc.3` 是桌面外壳版本。

之后正常使用 OpenCode，你的工作会被投递给小猪。只想在某个项目里启用、离线安装发布包或自定义目录时，参见[使用指南](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/opencode.md)。

## 离线与重试

事件先落盘再投递，已持久化的记录在游戏没打开时会保留，游戏重新启动后自动补投。插件每 5 秒重试一次；游戏的接收窗口是 7 天，超过窗口的事件会保留在磁盘上并停止自动投递。事件只有在游戏返回 `applied`、`duplicate` 或 `ignored` 之后才会从发件箱移除，重试始终使用原来的事件 ID，不会重复计数。

同一个 OpenCode 服务里的多个项目共用一个投递器，最后一个项目卸载插件时才停止。

## 目录与数据

插件优先在官方 `piggy` 数据目录中查找游戏接口。使用「独立完整存档」时，插件会根据当前存档选择自动找到接口，无需配置 `gameDirectory`；找不到该接口时再检查下表中的默认目录。事件队列保持原位置：

| 系统 | 游戏接口目录 | 插件队列目录 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | `%APPDATA%/piggy/work-endpoint` | `%APPDATA%/opencode-piggy-plugin` |
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/piggy/work-endpoint` | `~/Library/Application Support/opencode-piggy-plugin` |
| Linux | `$XDG_DATA_HOME/piggy/work-endpoint`，默认 `~/.local/share/piggy/work-endpoint` | `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode-piggy-plugin`，默认 `~/.config/opencode-piggy-plugin` |

Linux 的 `XDG_DATA_HOME` 仅在值为绝对路径时生效。统一数据目录没有接口时，插件会继续检查旧数据目录 `dsh-piggy` 和 `dsh-piggy-desktop`。显式设置的 `gameDirectory` 优先；如果它仍指向旧接口，可以移除该选项以恢复自动发现。

队列的 `events/` 里只保存事件 ID、类型和时间，不含聊天内容、代码或工具输出。游戏自定义了数据目录，或想改队列位置时，参见[使用指南](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/opencode.md#配置游戏目录与队列)。反馈问题时请不要分享游戏接口目录中的 `endpoint.json`，其中含本机认证令牌。

## 使用指南

[使用指南](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/opencode.md)涵盖 CLI 安装与停用、项目级配置、离线安装、目录选项和排障；[发布指南](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/docs/guides/releasing.md)说明如何打包与发布。

## 开发

仓库只包含插件本身：

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `packages/opencode-piggy/` | 插件：事件映射、持久发件箱、官方接口发现与 HTTP 投递 |
| `scripts/` | 安装脚本、类型检查与打包 |

开发依赖只有 TypeScript 和 Node 类型，源码工具使用 Node.js 22.15 或以上：

```sh
npm install --ignore-scripts
npm run check
```

从源码直接启用插件时，可以在仓库根目录运行 `node scripts/install-opencode.mjs --global`，或用 `--project="/path/to/project"` 只为一个项目启用。版本变化见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/WolalaQAQ/opencode-piggy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。
